subject: Thermostat shows E42 error
resolution: E42 means the heating system did not respond. Check that the breaker is on and the furnace door is closed, then restart the thermostat.

subject: Sensor not detected after battery change
resolution: Remove the battery for 30 seconds, reinsert it and hold the sensor next to the thermostat to re-pair.

subject: Schedule runs one hour late
resolution: The home time zone was wrong. Fix it in Profile > Home > Time zone; schedules update within a minute.

subject: Smart plug clicks but device does not turn on
resolution: The connected device's own switch was off. Leave the appliance switch on and control power from the plug.
